direction-type.words: Note: The "Reading as G Mello" lines are meant for if you are reading music written for a G Mello.
The "Reading as F Mello" lines are meant for if you're reading music written for F Mello / F Horn.
All lines assume you're using a G Mello, and the fingerings will correlate with the notes on your sheet music
Note: Instruments can play above and below the effective range, but is notated as the prefered playing range for most applicaitons
